invariants.rule: Import only package:harmony_ui/harmony_ui.dart. Never import lib/src/... paths and never reach into another package's internals.
invariants.why: The barrel is the only public boundary; src files are implementation detail and one of them (ohos_arc.dart) is intentionally not exported.

invariants.rule: Do not branch on theme.monochrome inside a component. Use OhosVisualPolicy: policy.tint for fills, policy.line for strokes, allows* for shadow/blur/ripple/animation, disabledFill and usesOutlines for disabled and outline states.
invariants.why: Theme data answers 'what colour', visual policy answers 'how to stay legible'. Reading the mode directly bypasses the e-ink adaptation and silently produces invisible controls.

invariants.rule: Every new value object reachable from OhosThemeData must implement == and hashCode. Consumers must not exhaustively switch over policy enums.
invariants.why: Missing equality makes InheritedWidget.updateShouldNotify a no-op, so theme changes never reach the widgets. Enumerating enum values breaks when a policy gains a mode.

invariants.rule: Content passed to showDialog / showOhosDialog must be wrapped in an explicit DefaultTextStyle. showMenu, showModalBottomSheet, Toast and Popup already provide a Material ancestor and do not need it.
invariants.why: showDialog attaches to the Navigator overlay without a Material ancestor. DefaultTextStyle.fallback is the yellow #FFFF00 double-underline alarm style. flutter_test also supplies that style, so widget tests cannot catch it - only a real e-ink screenshot can.

invariants.rule: An official maximum width is an upper bound, never a guaranteed width. Clamp it against the available width (screen minus margins) as well.
invariants.why: RenderFlex does not throw when a child exceeds its parent; it just paints off screen. This bug has been made twice: a 328vp max in a 340vp container, and a 400vp dialog max on a 360vp screen.

invariants.rule: Text inside a fixed-width container must use Expanded + maxLines: 1 + TextOverflow.ellipsis.
invariants.why: A bare Text in the 224vp menu overflows by a few pixels once padding shrinks; the overflow is nearly invisible by eye but fails in tests and on narrow screens.

invariants.rule: On a 16-level e-ink display, black at <=20% opacity is indistinguishable from white. Replace tinted fills with whitespace plus a 1px solid line; semi-transparent lines must be composited to an opaque colour. Shadows, BackdropFilter, ripples and long animations are effectively unavailable.
invariants.why: The simulator and ordinary screenshots do not reproduce this. Generated code that looks fine in a screenshot can render as nothing on the device.

invariants.rule: Do not translate ArkUI / HDS parameter names into Ohos* constructors, and do not assume Material analogues share parameters. Resolve the exact symbol in catalog.json first.
invariants.why: This library is a translation layer: its API deliberately diverges from both ArkUI and Flutter. The 0.6.0 removals (selected, isExpand, borderRadius, timeZone, BoxFit fit) are exactly the names an assistant is most likely to guess.

invariants.rule: Official control specs are split by device class (phone / PC / wearable / large screen). Only phone, tablet and large-screen forms are in scope here. Never apply a wearable value to a phone layout.
invariants.why: 149 of 233 annotated image measurements come from the wearable section. The apparent 'subheader 15vp vs 18fp' conflict is two different device classes, not a contradiction.

invariants.rule: For a numeric spec, resolve in this order: pattern.json -> float_sys.json -> float.json -> source/*.ets -> annotated design image. A design-image suggestion is not a component token. If the resource tables have no such entry, a documented constant is correct - do not invent a sys.float.* name.
invariants.why: 45 of 84 verified phone measurements have no token at all (e.g. the 8vp sheet top gap, the 448vp button max width). Searching harder for a token produces fabricated names.

invariants.rule: Do not edit doc/reference/ by hand. Refresh the upstream mirror with ./tool/upstream.sh (status / verify / all|api|ux|source|resources / index); fetch_*.sh alone does not update the manifest.
invariants.why: The reference tree is a generated mirror of official HarmonyOS docs, sources and resource tables.

invariants.rule: OhosThemeSwitcher must sit outside MaterialApp. OhosThemeController.mode is nullable (OhosThemeMode?) and must be null-checked before use.
invariants.why: The controller stores an OhosThemeData, not an enum; toggle() restores the last colour theme rather than cycling into e-ink.
